title: Crown Room Editing Guide v4
summary: Crown-only editing guide with lav sync for Hotel San Carlos rooftop exhaust replacement.
content:
Crown Room Editing Guide (v4 - Crown Only + Lav Sync)

Project: Ambition Mechanical - Rooftop Exhaust Fan Replacement Location: Hotel San Carlos, Downtown Phoenix (1928, 7-story Italian Renaissance Revival) Job: Kitchen fire restoration - rooftop exhaust fan replacement Shoot: March 5, 2026, 8:48-9:24 AM AZ Camera: DJI Ronin 4D (ProRes 422 LT, 3840x2160, 24fps) Drone: DJI Air 3 (HEVC, 2688x1512 / 3840x2160, 59.94fps) Source: /Volumes/SS8TB/Ambition Mechanical Services/20260305 Crown/organized/Crown-Room/

SCOPE: Crown Room clips ONLY (C0004-C0035 + Drone 0007/0008/0009/0013). NO Memorial Tower (C0036-C0069).

LUTs

  • Ronin 4D: /Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/LUT/R4D 6K Phntm ARRI LUTs G2/Standard (No WB Offset)/65x/Neutral 4D 65x.cube
  • Drone (D-Log): /Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/LUT/Technical_Camera_Profiles/Dji D-Log (2).cube

RECOMMENDED V4 EDIT STRUCTURE (35s target)

Opening (0-5s)

  • Drone 0007 (3s, orbit start) - Phoenix skyline, location establishment
  • C0035 (2s) - Worker getting tools, Ambition branded hallway

Setup / "Before" (5-11s)

  • C0033 (2s) - Kitchen fire damage interior (the problem)
  • C0007 (2s) - Damaged exhaust fan on rooftop
  • C0013 (2s) - HVAC unit context with historic brick

Process Montage (11-26s)

  • C0010 (2s) - Worker surveying the job
  • C0025 (3s) - Installing K-TECH unit
  • C0028 (2s) - Sealant close-up (hands working)
  • C0031 (3s) - Worker adjusting gear (hero vertical shot)
  • C0027 (2s) - Sealing the unit
  • C0022 (2s) - Installation detail
  • C0018 (1s) - Quick cut transition

Closing (26-35s)

  • C0029 (2s) - Final sealing work
  • C0004 (2s, LAV AUDIO) - Brief speech moment from lav
  • Drone 0009 (3s) - Pull-back from rooftop
  • Drone 0007 (2s, end of orbit) - Skyline bookend

Audio Plan

  • C0004 lav (2s) as the only dialogue moment, placed near the end for impact
  • Camera ambient from process shots as nat sound bed (tools, HVAC hum)
  • Music bed underneath for social energy
  • Loudnorm: I=-16, TP=-1.5, LRA=11

TECHNICAL SPECS

9:16 Crop from 16:9

  • Ronin 4D (3840x2160): crop=1215:2160:1313:0,scale=1080:1920
  • Drone 4K (3840x2160): crop=1215:2160:1313:0,scale=1080:1920,fps=24
  • Drone 2.7K (2688x1512): crop=851:1512:919:0,scale=1080:1920,fps=24

Output Format

  • ProRes 422: -c:v prores_ks -profile:v 2 -pix_fmt yuv422p10le
  • Audio: -c:a pcm_s16le -ar 48000
  • Frame rate: 24fps
  • Resolution: 1080x1920

Lav Sync Command (C0004 only)

ffmpeg -y -ss 127 -t 5.708333 -i DJI_12_20260305_084830.WAV -c:a pcm_s16le synced_audio.wav
ffmpeg -y -i C0004.MOV -i synced_audio.wav -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v copy -c:a pcm_s16le synced_C0004.mov

  • C0036-C0069: Memorial Tower Insulation (different location)
  • Drone 0010, 0011, 0012: Memorial Tower area (timestamps 9:43+ AM)
  • C0008, C0009, C0016: Low Gemini scores (below threshold)
